title: console: the row and record-page Delete confirmations name the objects a delete will cascade into, from the served cascadeDeleteObjects (ui half of #28001)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ③ ruling-directed. The maintainer's ruling B on #28001 (recorded in `6545218189`) says: "UI half follows on `plugin-grid` `rowCrudAffordances` / `ObjectGrid` delete and the record-page delete confirm. It is a `domain:ui` card, blocked by the server PR." The server PR, #28451, has merged (`6e0b16ac`), so this card is the carrier. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: any user deleting a record whose children cascade. HotCRM: deleting a lead silently deletes its campaign memberships (#27380 row 4).
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`.

## What the server now serves (on `main`)

- `GET /meta/object/:name` (both doors, the cached one included) and the app bundle's object entries carry `cascadeDeleteObjects: string[]` beside `item`. The schema is `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects` / `GetMetaItemCachedResponseSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`.
- It lists, by object name, every object a delete of this object can also delete: the transitive cascade closure from the rule the delete runs (`master_detail` by default, a `lookup` / `tree` with `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`). Each object appears once, in the order the delete reaches it. `restrict` / `set_null` relations are not listed.
- `[]` means nothing cascades. **Absent means no engine answered, never that nothing cascades.** It is absent on a draft read and on the list read (`GET /meta/object`).
- It is object-level only: no record ids and no counts. Object names, not field names: a field name could disclose a field another object's ADR-0106 mask removes.

## Wanted

- The row delete confirm (`plugin-grid` `rowCrudAffordances` / `ObjectGrid`) and the record-page delete confirm (`RecordDetailView`) add one generated line naming those objects by their labels (resolve the labels on the client from the names, in the user's language). Show nothing extra when the list is `[]`.
- ⛔ No second copy of "which relations cascade" in the client. When the key is absent, the confirmation says nothing about children rather than guessing.
- ⛔ No `confirmText` or other author key (ruling B, "No author key").

Blocked-by: none (#28451 merged).
Related: #28001 (parent, server half landed), #27380 (row 4), #27823.

Dedupe words: delete confirmation cascade children list, cascadeDeleteObjects console, delete confirm names child objects.
